scenario: Negation under `logical` is supported per LLOG.11.5 — a rule with a `no Foo` LHS that emits `Bar logical` produces an absence-justified Bar. Asserting Foo makes the negation pattern fail; truth maintenance retracts Bar automatically. After pump (no Trig → Quiet asserted), then assert-Trig + pump: WM has Trig only (1 fact); Quiet auto-retracted via the `(logical (not Trig)) (assert Quiet)` shape.
rules_ds:
schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

schema Quiet scope logical:
    marker: Int key

rule q:
    no Trig
->
    emit Quiet logical marker: 1
